web.title: 45 new behavioral health projects to know
web.description:
22. Ann Arbor-based Michigan Medicine broke ground on the Janice M. Granger Behavioral Health Building, a 64-bed, $83 million behavioral health facility, during an Aug. 5 ceremony in Lansing, Mich. The facility will serve adult, geriatric, and child and adolescent patients.
25. Sauget, Ill.-based SIHF Healthcare will [build](https://www.beckersbehavioralhealth.com/behavioral-health-news/illinois-approves-231m-replacement-hospital/) a $231 million hospital in Cahokia Heights that will replace Touchette Regional Hospital. The new campus will increase Touchette’s psychiatric bed count, from 38 to 96, split among 24 adolescent beds, 24 senior beds and 48 adult beds.
41. Edison, N.J.-based Hackensack Meridian Health [opened](https://www.beckersbehavioralhealth.com/behavioral-health-capital-investment/hackensack-meridian-opens-behavioral-health-expansion-amid-30-rise-in-youth-admissions/) Belle Mead, N.J.-based Carrier Clinic’s $40 million, 43,000-square-foot expansion project to expand care for children and adolescents facing mental health crises. The project adds 52 inpatient beds for youths and includes multi-sensory rooms, The Cohen Community Resource and Education Center as a family resource and training center, and a medical staff suite for teaching.
